formula: r = clamp(rating, 0, capRating); maximum * (r / (scale + r)) / (capRating / (scale + capRating))
scaleMeaning: Curvature parameter; curve is normalized to reach maximum at capRating
capMeaning: 350 rating reaches the configured maximum; additional rating gives no further chance
accuracyMeaning: Bonus in probability points, not final hit chance
penetrationMeaning: Provisional counter-strength only; block interaction not yet defined
notes: Primary attribute conversion factors remain unchanged.
Critical damage bonus is not diminished by this model.
No random critical, block, dodge or hit rolls are added to damage simulations.
Weapon critical and shield block units remain unresolved and are not silently combined with ratings.
